data.body: **[P2] Defer terminal hooks until the response boundary succeeds.** This guard covers customer serialization and large-payload checkpointing, but after this callback `ExecutionManager.close()` still runs and `DurableHandler` still serializes the envelope and writes the output stream. If any of those steps throws, Lambda retries after plugins observed `SUCCEEDED` and OTel may have exported a terminal Workflow span; the `FAILED` path has the same problem. Move terminal end dispatch to an outer handler-thread boundary encompassing manager closure and response emission, reporting `RETRYING` on failure, and add a failing-output-stream regression test.
